footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Credicorp: after S/157M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.9% to S/28.6B in 2025. Operating income rose 27.1% to S/9.9B, a 34.8% margin.
Net income rose 25.9% to S/6.9B, or S/87.08 per share. Operating cash flow was S/8.6B and free cash flow S/8.3B, versus S/14.2B; Credicorp returned S/3.2B through dividends.
watch: Free cash flow fell 41.4% to S/8.3B.
Cash ended the year at S/49.0B.
sources: Credicorp Ltd. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
